method: Visual reading of generated source contact sheets; no game, automated asset checks, or runtime tests.

userAcceptance.scope: All four v01 source videos and GIF previews

observations: The left loader alternates leg poses while retaining the ramrod; the gunner remains by the cannon and the group stays in place.
Both hamster identities and the right-facing cannon silhouette remain recognizable across the sampled poses.
The gunner's lower body is obscured by the carriage, so exact foot contact and wheel rotation coordination remain user-review items.
